units.title: Regulations
units.summary: Understand the rules, responsibilities, and limits that shape a remote pilot’s decisions.
outcomes: Identify remote pilot responsibilities and operating limitations.
Apply regulatory requirements to realistic flight scenarios.

units.title: Airspace
units.summary: Read aviation charts and determine where a proposed UAS operation can take place.
outcomes: Interpret airspace classifications and sectional-chart information.
Recognize airport operations, restrictions, and authorization needs.

units.title: Weather
units.summary: Connect weather information to aircraft performance, flight planning, and safe operating decisions.
outcomes: Find and interpret aviation weather reports.
Explain how weather conditions can affect a UAS operation.
units.watchNote: Start with the aviation-weather and METAR demonstrations. A full Weather overview video has not yet been added.

units.title: Loading & Performance
units.summary: Evaluate how loading, balance, and operating conditions affect aircraft performance.
outcomes: Explain the effects of weight, balance, and center of gravity.
Apply performance concepts to a proposed aircraft load and flight.

units.title: Operations
units.summary: Bring the course concepts together in preflight planning, communication, and operational judgment.
outcomes: Plan preflight checks, crew communication, and emergency responses.
Use sound judgment to assess and manage an operational scenario.
